# Akoode Technologies

> Akoode Technologies is an AI and software development company based in Gurugram, India and Oklahoma, USA, delivering AI integration, custom software, mobile app development, and digital transformation services. This file guides AI agents and LLMs on accessing and using content from akoode.com.

Akoode permits summarization, RAG/indexing, and attributed quoting of public content. AI model training, full-content scraping, and redistribution without consent are restricted — see the full policy below.
